Try the Calculator Accommodation for seasonal farm workers Discover our range of products Keops Agriculture Our Clients We create Beautiful Bespoke Garden Rooms for your Garden but our Commercial Clients include… 'We wanted an Art Studio for my wife, a hobby artist. I did a lot of desk research, looking at modular garden offices, log cabins. We chose KEOPS as we really liked the quality and 'Bespoke' nature of the log cabins, the company itself and the people. We took them up on the offer to visit their offices in Evesham and met Rob, who leads the family business. We met in their excellent log cabin offices and were shown around the display units. We placed an order soon after and even though we are a relatively small customer, we have had excellent service, updates and communications - we had a challenge with our base (our problem) and KEOPS were really excellent in helping us to resolve the issue - Most impressive are the people, always supportive, professional and responsive - special mention to Rob, Fiona our liaison throughout and Aaron, the installer. Our log cabin was installed on Wednesday - It looks naked as it has yet to be treated (!) We are very, very pleased. And I forgot to mention, a competitive price!' 'We are delighted with the end result and, in the early light of dawn, the shingles look beautiful.  We will send you another picture when it has all been painted.  Thank you for your hard work.  Having built a log cabin myself earlier this year I thought that I had a good appreciation of the work involved but I could not have imagined just how demanding the shingles would be.  Your skill, energy and application were much appreciated.  I was amazed how much you accomplished in just 2 days.' 'We would like to say a big thank you for the helpful advice and support we received from Rob while considering repurposing our garden cabin, which was installed by Keops around 10 years ago. We approached them about carrying out additional work, but instead of recommending unnecessary work, they took the time to discuss our plans and kindly suggested alternative solutions that would meet our needs without extra expense. Their honesty, professionalism, and customer-focused approach were greatly appreciated. It's refreshing to deal with a company that genuinely puts its customers first, even many years after the original installation. We would highly recommend them for both their quality workmanship and more recently excellent aftercare service!' 'We had been talking about getting a garden cabin for a while for an unused space at the top of the garden, but had no idea how to go about it. We browsed the Internet, but had lots of questions - did we want wood or composite? How much would it cost us? Would it be warm enough? What size should it be to accommodate our needs? How would we get electricity into it? etc etc. Gareth was extremely helpful answering ALL of our questions and from that point we knew that Keops was the right choice! We visited the site, discussed all the options with Gareth and placed an order for a 6m x 3m Moderna cabin. Communication was great throughout the process and we found the Keops team to be knowledgeable, helpful and very professional. The quality of the cabin is superb and we are so impressed how warm it is. Everyone is extremely complimentary when they see it and we are so chuffed with it. Thank you to everyone at Keops!' 'We would like to thank you Fiona and your team at Keops , with special thanks to the three lads who came and built the Keops log cabin on our land. The cabin is wonderful, we are really happy with it. It is solid and sturdy, has been well insulated and looks as though it will be still standing in 100 years time.  The lads ( builders)  were hard working, skilled and good mannered guys. Steve, the driver, was also very nice and friendly. Matt and Adam are beavering away doing the fit out .  Thanks for everything, great service, great product.' 'We are delighted with the cabin and the quality of both product and service. It has been a pleasure to work with professionals at every turn – it is how every business should be!' 'The workshop was erected this week and my builders said it was 98% perfection – believe me they are very hard to please! The 2% downgrade was down to having to go and buy another kilo of roof felt nails.  Seriously, they have built a number of timber buildings from scratch and from kits and stated that this was by far the best quality and design they had worked on and at a price they felt was lower than it would cost to buy the wood!  Thanks all, it looks great and it has once again been a pleasure to deal with you.' 'Many thanks for being such a wonderful company to deal with. From the first telephone call asking for advice, to manufacture, delivery and installation. The service has been first class in every way. Our Dutch Roof cabin has exceeded our expectations and we would happily recommend Keops to anyone who asks!  You are all so friendly and approachable and not at all pushy and we are delighted with the end result.  Once we have finished painting we will send you some photos to add to your gallery.' 'I would just like to take this opportunity to thank you all for the professional and efficient workmanship, received from all in your team. The finished log cabin looks absolutely fantastic and to say that we are delighted would be an understatement.  Your team of fitters were also very polite, efficient and worked extremely hard. The finished product is great , thank you. We would be more than pleased to recommend your company 150%.' 'Just a quick note of thanks for the cabin, it is up and looking great, will send some photos once painted. The erection team were very impressive, I’m glad I went for that option, I would still have a pile of bits now if I hadn’t. I think you are aware that the only problem was a twisted french door, which I believe has been re-ordered. Again I was impressed as I did not need to point this out it was identified to me before I even went to see the cabin and a solution already put into place. This kind of after sales service is exactly why I chose KEOPS over other companies.' 'It is some 2 1/2 years since you provided us with the cabin for our garden and we have to say we are just as delighted with the new car barn which now stands proudly on our drive. An excellent job once again by all your team, and a particular thank you to you, Richard, for the kind assistance you afforded with the difficulties we experienced with our local conservation officer. Once again its been a pleasure working with your team.' 'We would just like to say a big thank you to you all for the log cabin. From start to finish the service was fantastic, nothing was too much trouble. As for the team that put the cabin up, what can I say, they were true professionals – everything arrived when it should have and work was completed in the time stated; well done lads, a credit to your team.' 'Just to say thank you to you ALL for your efficient services once again. The 9m x 3m cabin was delivered on time and has now been erected, fully furnished as a tandem garage – enclosed are two “pride & joy” motor vehicles! Thrilled with the results, raving comments from many & you never know a further (third!) cabin may one day be on the order list?!' 'Just a little (belated) e-mail to say thank you for your work in organising everything regarding our new ‘shed’. I’ve finally finished painting it, landscaping the area and putting up the guttering! Your team were amazing and were very efficient, professional, polite and friendly (even though they finished putting it up in the rain and dark, after a 13 hour day!) I thanked them on the day in telling them how brilliant they were and have sent you some photographs of the building in it’s finished state. My neighbours now have ‘shed-envy’ like you wouldn’t believe.' 'It’s now been almost two years since I purchased the cabin from you, and I had meant to send an email so many times to say thank you! I love my cabin, it was money well spent and I have highly recommended you. Building it was quite a challenge mainly as at the time it would not stop raining, but it went together really well and two years on it still looks great!  We use it in multiple ways; as a place to get away, play room for the young children and an xbox and pool room for our teenagers. I really couldn’t imagine life without it now.' 'It's fantastic and the guys who constructed it were incredible. One day it was a concrete slab and the next it was up, wind and water tight. Worth every penny. Our friends and family can’t stay away. Its so practical incorporating the garage and we were surprised how warm it is and how easy it is to heat in winter. The design process with Keops was so simple. I just provided the floor plan I fancied and the rest is history. Thank you for a great customer experience.' 'Well the cabin is up and complete, on time and we could not be happier with the outcome. Just a few words to say many thanks for all of your help, from design up to the finished product. I would also like to say what a brilliant work force you provided, from the extremely helpful driver who delivered the cabin. And the helpful and industrious guys who built the cabin, in very inclement weather, they were here at 7am on Monday and worked late, and again at 7am on the Tuesday until they finished, and they could not have been more informative and help full.' 'I am writing to say what a good experience it has been dealing with your Company.  It has been a welcome contrast in these times to have the ‘phone answered by a real person, rather than frustrating menus/messages, and then to receive friendly and personal attention from people who clearly know what they are talking about.' 'Just a short note to say how happy we are, not only with the quality of the product itself, but also the design and construction. The building looks fantastic at the end of the garden – the design with a small door and window makes it work as a building rather than purely a garage. Further Rick and his team were excellent in laying the slab, ensuring the delivery and during building. Not only did they do a great job – but they were pleasant, punctual, and respected our property and that of our neighbours.' Leave Keops a Review Request Your Free Brochure Today! Case Study The New Forest Fruit Company Nestled between the Solent and the picturesque New Forest National Park, the New Forest Fruit Company is producing some of the UK’s finest soft fruits and asparagus. Under the leadership of CEO Sandy Booth the business has made significant strides in improving the working conditions for its staff. Recognising the importance of comfortable and reliable accommodation for his workforce, Booth partnered with us to provide living quarters for the farm's seasonal workers We caught up with CEO Sandy Booth during construction of the latest cabins. Watch our interview below to learn more about the project. “Labour is one of our biggest issues… people don’t want to come into agriculture or horticulture but if we’ve got some really nice accommodation for them to come into… that is one of the big ticks when people come to the farm.” — Sandy Booth, CEO Do I need planning permission to install cabins for seasonal farm workers? In all cases planning permission would be required to site a caravan (mobile home) on the land. This does not matter whether the land is classified as agricultural, pasture, brownfield, greenfield etc. etc. or it does not matter whether the land is in conservation area, AONB etc. etc. the siting of a caravan (mobile home) will always need full planning permission. In many instances when we look at farmers land, they may well already have permission to site caravans for workers. In these instances it is likely the planning will simply say allowed to site caravans without definition of type / size etc. This therefore makes the mobile homes exempt from planning. If you do not have this permission, then you will need to apply for planning permission. It is true that applying for a mobile home (caravan) will be simpler to obtain. The reason why, is due to the fact that it is not classified as ‘permanent’ and therefore not classified as a ‘development’. This will have much more ability to get approval through, whether that is for farm workers, farm managers, or in some situations having a mobile home for site security is looked at favourably. What qualifies as a ‘mobile home’ under UK planning law? To be classed as a mobile home, the cabin must: Be moveable in one or two sections Be no larger than 20m x 6.8m, and under 3.05m high Be single-storey Must be designed for human habitation If your cabin meets these criteria, it falls under the Caravan Act and may not require full planning permission. What is a Lawful Development Certificate (LDC), and do I need one? An LDC isn’t planning permission, it’s proof from your local council that planning permission isn’t required. It offers legal peace of mind and is highly recommended when using mobile cabins for seasonal accommodation. What if I want to house workers year-round? If the cabins are used beyond seasonal periods or become permanent residences, you’ll likely need full planning permission and building regulations approval. About Us Nagle and Sisters is a well established jewellery brand created by three sisters. Having always been close, Sophie, Dominique and Chloé knew that one day they would work together to create something truly beautiful. Creativity and passion for different cultures, art and design comes naturally to the girls, a love that they all share and have nurtured over the years. Being of dual nationality, French and English, the girls have had a perfectly ‘franglais’ upbringing. Currently based between London and Montréal, the Nagle girls launched their first collection Pyramid in 2015. With a combined background of jewellery and fashion design, marketing and sales, the girls spent years honing and expanding their skills. Nagle and Sisters is an amalgamation of three minds, three characters but just one style... theirs. Sophie, Dominique and Chloé wanted to design, make and sell everyday jewellery that they themselves would wear and covet. The driving force was to make jewellery that meant something to the wearer, to form a connection with each piece. The style is modern ethnic, merging rough hand made details and textures with elegant, clean designs and materials. Whilst the collections combine strong historical influences with current high fashion trends, the designs are contemporary with an emphasis on texture and detail. "Everything is made by us in East London. We wanted to stay grounded by staying involved with the whole process, from sourcing materials to selling the final product. We find that we hugely benefit from being a part of every aspect of the business. We design pieces quite naturally, letting ideas evolve and change.
